name: caspian-instagram-functions
description: Firebase Cloud Functions for the Caspian Store Instagram channel — Facebook-Login OAuth exchange, feed read, and comment moderation (e.g. for the Caspian POS). Requires META_APP_ID and META_APP_SECRET secrets: run `firebase functions:secrets:set META_APP_ID` / `META_APP_SECRET` before deploy.

scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
